Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who is reserved.
Current_Reflective_Version: At social gatherings, I tend to stay quiet and observe rather than actively join conversations.
Adaptation_Rationale: Abstract self-label → concrete social behavior scenario

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who is generally trusting.
Current_Reflective_Version: When I meet someone new, I tend to give them the benefit of the doubt until proven otherwise.

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who tends to be lazy.
Current_Reflective_Version: When I have a free day with no obligations, I often spend it without accomplishing anything productive.

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who is relaxed, handles stress well.
Current_Reflective_Version: When unexpected problems arise, I usually stay calm and think clearly about what to do next.

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who has few artistic interests.
Current_Reflective_Version: I rarely feel moved or inspired by art, music, or poetry — they don't hold much personal value for me.

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who is outgoing, sociable.
Current_Reflective_Version: I feel energized after spending time with a group of people, even if they are not close friends.
Adaptation_Rationale: Abstract self-label → energy/affect after social interaction

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who tends to find fault with others.
Current_Reflective_Version: When someone makes a mistake, my first instinct is to notice what they did wrong rather than understand why.
Adaptation_Rationale: Negative self-label → automatic cognitive response pattern

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who does a thorough job.
Current_Reflective_Version: When I take on a task, I make sure every detail is done properly before considering it finished.
Adaptation_Rationale: Abstract work ethic → task completion behavior

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who gets nervous easily.
Current_Reflective_Version: Before important events (exams, interviews, presentations), I often feel anxious to the point where it affects my preparation.
Adaptation_Rationale: Abstract nervousness → specific pre-event anxiety with consequences

Original_BFI10_Item_Rammstedt_John_2007: I see myself as someone who has an active imagination.
Current_Reflective_Version: I often find myself imagining alternative scenarios or mentally exploring 'what if' possibilities.
